milestone: G4 runtime mount and signed-journal integrity correction
architecture_decisions: Blueprint v1.1 is the source of truth
Companion is text-only and cannot commit world mutations
Durable world changes are authoritative, revisioned and idempotent
Free Desktop Bridge and Paid API use one AGM Snapshot and Decision contract
AGM directs content but all durable effects remain validated proposals
forbidden_actions: add STT, TTS, voice, voxel or blockchain dependencies
push, deploy, publish or upload externally
